title: Le Creuset – Enameled cast iron baking dish No. 18 – Vintage
description:
Vintage Le Creuset enameled cast iron baking dish (No. 18). Designed for cooking enthusiasts, it offers excellent heat distribution for perfectly cooked dishes.
Elegant and timeless design, ideal for roasting, baking, or slow-cooked meals. Features a beautiful color and a durable enamel surface for easy cleaning.
As a vintage item, it shows a nice patina and possible signs of use. Please check the photos carefully, as they are part of the description.
